hypotheses.mechanism: Linear Intent Continuation Fiber; task authority is a non-copyable continuation consumed/reissued at material boundaries
Nested task_epoch under lease_epoch, checked at every material boundary
Durable per-task event history with consent transitions and deterministic replay
Revocable task capability required by GWT/reentry/effect/state consumers
WorkspaceEpisode task seal; only episodes reconstructed under current seal may cause material use
New requests remain unresolved alternatives until a consent determination collapses current-task transition
Task-local MVCC snapshot/revision and compare-and-set on all material commits
Merkle-linked immutable task ancestry from user consent through completion/reentry
One current-task actor mailbox; unrelated arrivals become non-executable observations until explicit handoff
Two-phase task handoff PREPARE_SWITCH -> USER_CONSENT -> ACTIVATE_NEW_TASK with rollback on uncertainty
ClayCode typestate makes RUNNING/WAITING_USER/DONE/FAILED/CANCELLED transitions compile-time visible
Task-switch is a non-monotone causal cut; all pre-cut task derivations become non-materializable

selection_reason: Most structurally different from a mutable task row while still executable as a finite discriminator. H02/H07 form the strongest deliberately conventional counterbaseline. H12 overlaps MCM and was not selected to avoid duplicate research.
